classical_condition: One on-path observer of one client link defines the threat model.
mapping: Tool feedback re-enters later model requests; tool egress, model link and recipients are separately observable.
evidence: Task information is recovered on T (WRA), on M (CB, ANT) and at the recipient (PT: metadata 14.53% vs prior 17.97%; +arguments 27.71%). 0 of 9 protection settings act on M.
unresolved: Cross-source visibility; no causal feedback ablation across links.

classical_condition: Transit encryption leaves plaintext visible to the addressed recipient.
mapping: Agents send user-derived arguments to many third-party tools.
unresolved: Argument minimization vs task success is unmeasured.

classical_condition: Passive observation is the default fingerprinting model.
mapping: Content-borne probes elicit repairs, choices or lure following.
evidence: AgentTrace 66.8% (initial) to 96.0% (ordered repairs) at 50 probes; AgentTell 61.1% of 7,630 loaded sessions.
unresolved: Error normalization as a defense is untested.

mapping: Agents reuse long system prompts and tool schemas, which favors prefix sharing.
evidence: No direct Agent setting measures cache timing.
unresolved: Cross-tenant TTFT on shared tool-schema prefixes.

classical_condition: The visited page is an unambiguous label.
mapping: Intent, execution, success and authorization are distinct targets.
evidence: 42/44 settings report the label basis; execution outcome is fully reported in 13/38 applicable settings.
unresolved: Authorization labels need principal and policy.

classical_condition: Unknown boundaries and background require localization.
mapping: Tool bursts, model waits and concurrent tasks.
evidence: 43/44 settings use evaluator-supplied boundaries; the paper's pilot reports IoU .5 F1 <= .274.
unresolved: Localization at a stated false-alarm budget under new loads.

mapping: Agent timing is machine-regular; retries and repairs are deterministic signals.
evidence: AgentTrace repair order; Trace command n-grams; AgentPrint identity F1 .8660.

mapping: Each tool call conditions the next one.
Composition, topology, scaffold and model aliases change.
evidence: Composition .67 to .18; topology about .83 to .52; scaffold .981 to .815. Only 4/44 settings name a held-out deployment axis.
unresolved: One source per axis; joint holdouts absent.

evidence: Open-world tests in 2/44 settings; 0/44 state a deployment prevalence; honeypot 8 candidates in 8,130,731 interactions without labels.

classical_condition: Random splits leak through shared items.
mapping: Random trace or trial splits with shared tasks or probes.
evidence: AgentPrint per-agent random traces; MARK 30 trial folds; AgentTrace reuses held-out probe identities across trials.
unresolved: Group splits by task, prompt and probe.

classical_condition: Defenses must face attackers refit on protected data.
mapping: An unchanged learner family can refit on protected captures.
evidence: Adaptation located in 4/9 protection settings (2/4 privacy); M3 replay: fixed-position cover D0 .37-.63 vs refit/position rule 1.00.
unresolved: Report frozen and refit attackers for every defense.

mapping: Padding leaves counts, order and destinations.
evidence: CB size-excluded features still score .540/.587; M3 replay: under 4,096/16,384-byte body padding, destination order alone identifies the action (BA 1.00).
unresolved: Agent-workload padding with adapted attacker on M.

classical_condition: Shape at the last observed hop.
mapping: Gateways and relays repacketize SSE and multiplex tasks.
evidence: Live OHTTP binds relay trust; the paper's pilot compares Shared and Dedicated connections. M3 replay: unpadded HTTP headers (operation path) let a refit RF separate read cover (BA .79 vs .62).

classical_condition: Overhead must be matched to protection.
mapping: Bytes and latency plus tokens and tool quota.
evidence: Live OHTTP about 13x bytes and 11x latency; defense cost located in 2/9 protection settings; M3 replay bytes 1.25-1.40x.
unresolved: Cost on the same protected runs.

classical_condition: Cover is discarded at an endpoint and performs no application work.
evidence: WRA five decoys .770 to .565 with utility only for the visibility intervention; M3 replay: live-write cover keeps 3.2-11.2% state integrity and lowers goal success to 87.2-87.8% with identical transit privacy to transport-terminated cover.
unresolved: Planner-visible decoy feedback with an LLM planner.

classical_condition: Dummy traffic is indistinguishable from real traffic.
mapping: Executed cover at a fixed count or position is countable.
evidence: M3 replay: one decoy at a fixed position lowers a frozen attacker to .37-.63 but a position rule or refit attacker recovers BA 1.00; random placement leaves best BA .62-.79 (chance .167).
unresolved: WRA decoy shuffling vs adapted attacker is unresolved.

mapping: Defenses that alter prompts or decoding change function.
evidence: AgentTrace identity prompts/temperature (attribution above 94%); matched utility not located.

classical_condition: (no classical analogue) Isolate cover state and planner feedback.
mapping: Shadow execution on isolated state; cover response hidden from the planner.
evidence: M3 replay: isolated and transport-terminated cover give 100% state integrity and goal success with the same transit privacy as live writes.
unresolved: Isolation audit with an LLM planner and real quotas.
